summary: Ming Shing Group Holdings Ltd (MSW) filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of its acquisition of PMA Nano Carbon Tech Ltd for US$110 million consideration, settled by issuing unsecured convertible promissory notes to the sellers (PMA Technology Holdings Ltd, Legend Master Development Ltd, F.F.Formation Holding Co. Ltd). The transaction closed on June 9, 2026, per the stock purchase agreement dated May 26, 2026. No board recommendation or advisors are named. The mechanics involve convertible notes, suggesting equity overhang potential upon conversion. Watch for conversion terms and dilution impact on existing shareholders.
